title: Hekaton: SQL Server's Memory-Optimized OLTP Engine
authors: Cristian Diaconu, Craig Freedman, Erik Ismert, Per-Ake Larson, Pravin Mittal, Ryan Stonecipher, Nitin Verma, Mike Zwilling
description: Hekaton is Microsoft's memory-optimized OLTP engine integrated into SQL Server, achieving 10-100x throughput improvements via latch-free data structures, optimistic multiversion concurrency control, and compilation of stored procedures to native machine code.
